notes.title: Winter Update 1.5.3
notes.notes:
[h2]Onset 1.5.3 (Protocol Compatibility 5)[/h2]

[b][h3]Client update[/h3][/b]

Add function [b]EnableSnowParticles(bEnable)[/b]

Add function [b]SetLandscapeSnowAlpha(Val)[/b]

Example usage:
[code]
AddEvent("OnPackageStart", function()
    EnableSnowParticles(true)
    SetLandscapeSnowAlpha(1.0)
end)
[/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35359927/c08e7d1bbf0c6b295be70c987e7ef162dfeeeb1d.png[/img]

The loadstring function now has a 2nd optional parameter for the package name. You can specify a different package where the code will be executed in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35359927/eb59276940436c81b3cfd0b426baa23a09a26497.png[/img]

For example you could create a console function that executes code in a specific package. In the above picture you can see the new snow function being executed in the package 'default'.

[i]Code used:[/i]
[code]AddEvent("OnConsoleInput", function(input)

	local cmd
	local args = {}
	for word in input:gmatch("%w+") do
		if cmd == nil then
			cmd = word
		else
			table.insert(args, word)
		end
	end
	
	if cmd == "x" then
		
		if args[1] == nil then
			print("Usage: x <package_name> <code>")
			return true
		end
		
		local code = input:sub(string.len(args[1]) + 4)
		
		print("Package Name:", args[1])
		print("Code to be executed in package:", code)		
		
		loadstring(code, args[1])
		
		return true
		
	end
	
end)
[/code]

[b]Add two new constants to Lua.[/b]

[b]_PACKAGENAME[/b]
Holds the name of the current package.

[b]_ONSETVERSION[/b]
Contains the current Onset version as a string.

Example usage:
[code]print("This message comes from", _PACKAGENAME)[/code]

[b]Add the following missing members of the Lua [i]math[/i] table.[/b]

[code]pi
huge
mininteger
maxinteger
[/code]

Example usage:
[code]print(math.pi)[/code]

notes.title: Winter Update
notes.notes:
[b]Enable new winter functions:[/b]

[code]EnableSnowParticles(bEnable)[/code]
Enable snow particles in player view.

[code]SetLandscapeSnowAlpha(Alpha)[/code]
Changes how much snow is visible on the landscape. A value of 0 means no snow at all and a value of 1 means fully covered with snow.

Both functions are client side.

This update also includes a maintenance update for the WebUIs. Please report any problems with scripted WebUIs or the main menu of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35359927/6199771e134b7c8c04c0e187f79a7b9b613f5c5b.png[/img]

notes.title: Halloween Update 1.3.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Cemetery[/h1]

[h1]Truck[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35359927/5711b3dfdebae72a048cbff5783bfa3b3e259ec2.png[/img]


[h1]Other changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Support .m4a audio files.
[*] Increase SetSoundPitch limit to 10.
[*] Event OnPlayerCrouch can now be cancelled.
[*] Parameter "radius" in CreateSound3D is now optional.
[*] Pak files can now be placed in the %LocalAppData%\Onset\Saved\PakFiles directory, bypassing the 2GB download limit.
[*] Weapon equip should not be possible when playing certain animations.
[*] Add Set/GetPlayerJumpZVelocity.
[*] Adjust moon position so that it rises at ~21:00 and goes down at ~6:00, fixes dark lighting in early and late night.
[*] Prefer aiming over sprinting, sprinting will be stopped when a player wants to aim.
[*] Update Unreal Engine to 4.25.4
[*] Function DrawTextureEx parameters now reflect the same parameters as described here: https://docs.unrealengine.com/en-US/...ure/index.html
[*] Add Cast function to cast between different types of Unreal components and actors.
[*] The global fog intensity has been increased for the Halloween styled update.
[/list]

notes.title: Onset Steam Release
notes.notes:
[b]Release Information[/b]

Onset is now available on Steam!

The Early Access phase and your support will give me the chance to turn this personal project
into something bigger. So, thank you to everyone who supports Onset!

[b]Early Access[/b]

Please keep in mind that Onset is launching in Early Access. Meaning that especially at the beginning you will notice some bugs which will be fixed during the Early Access.
Some bugs or errors may also arise from the game mode of a particular server you are playing on.

[b]Modding Update[/b]

I have good news for those who want to import custom 3D models in Onset. A new tool will help
you to simplify the process of importing your models.

Please see the corresponding wiki page: https://dev.playonset.com/wiki/Modding

[b]Server now available via steamcmd[/b]

If you would like to host a server for Onset then you can already download the files for it.
Another server update will be released tomorrow before the release.

Setup guide: https://dev.playonset.com/wiki/DedicatedServer
